entry.description:
`XmlLayout` and `XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J` write each CR and LF in the message, the exception text and the NDC as a character reference (`++`, `+
+`), so they read back exactly. A parser read a CR as LF, and CR LF and LF were indistinguishable. Text with a line break is escaped instead of written as CDATA. Visible change: a multi-line message or stack trace is one physical line in the file. This applies to `Transform.WriteEscapedXmlString` as well (ANT-2026-HQWYRAWL, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
